title: Research: flag-43 I−G/2 side correction at #3508 co-hosted cut costs +2 rank mass (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Bounded follow-up under priority revision 6, card `p104-side-correction`. Merged [#3508](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3508) gives a zero-added-mass head-step repair R0 for flag 43 and leaves open the cost of the `I − G/2` side correction at the co-hosted chart. This package answers that OQ for entry `(59,21)` (`G[59,21]=1` ⇒ add `−1/2·X21` into `Y59`).

On R0, four concrete corrections replace `Y59`'s terminal transport at 3525 while the head is still co-hosted (`Y59` in `W6`, `X21` in FULL, both spanning `15`):

| Word | Δ transports | Δ ADDs | Δ rank mass | Profile Δ vs R0 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| **T** (target lift `W6→FULL`, ADD, descend) | +1 | +1 | **+2** | `H1 − H2 + H3` |
| **S** (source detour `FULL→F59→FULL`) | +2 | +1 | **+2** | `2H1` |
| **P** (one private-copy lifetime) | +1 | +1 | **+1** | `H1` |
| **T48** (whole row 59 on T's lift) | +1 | +48 | **+2** | `H1 − H2 + H3` |

Native `check_native.validate()` passes each coefficient-0 word (incl. two new `FULL ↔ F59` recipes). Real words fail only at `Y59`'s endpoint; only `Y59` changes.

**Obstruction (class Z = #3508’s).** Zero added rank mass is impossible for all 28 insertion placements: events 625/884 force head `131` of `X12` into `X21`; `G[59,12]=0` keeps `131` outside `Y59`'s final; added non-private mass is even ⇒ strict min **+2**. The published end-cut detour also costs +2, so **co-host discount = 0**. P’s +1 needs an inherited private-copy discard (admissibility left open; strict bill remains +2 if discard is disallowed).

**Scoped bill. No new kappa.** Selected κ stays 0.001672660197076918.

## Result

Tip: `26394881f0a183ca0df3d986ec58aa56900ada6c`.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/p104-flag43-side-correction-bill/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-flag43-side-correction-bill/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-flag43-side-correction-bill/independent.py
python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B research/p104-flag43-side-correction-bill/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-flag43-side-correction-bill
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_P104_FLAG43_SIDE_CORRECTION_BILL flag=43 entry=(59,21) coefficient=-1/2 zero_mass_placements=0/28 … strict_min_added_rank=2 … cohost_discount=0 native_validate=4/4 no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_FLAG43_SIDE_CORRECTION_BILL_INDEPENDENT … rows_changed=Y59_only … no_new_kappa
PASS_P104_FLAG43_SIDE_CORRECTION_BILL_TESTS cases=14 clean_read_only=1 scanners=2
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/p104-flag43-side-correction-bill outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` and still fires under `-O`.

## Overlap and credit

Closest priors: [#3508](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3508) (R0 + OQ2), [#3456](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3456) (chronology, cited only), `research/p104-side-correction-rank-obstruction` (end-cut +2; this package’s novelty is co-hosted placement, 0/28 obstruction + forcing chain, P route, native validation). Soft-overlap checked against open [#3532](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3532) (flag 1; untouched). Does not reopen deferred repair clones, #3441/#3436/#3421/#3411, or the merged readout series through #2883.
